method: Original geometry with material/evidence face tags retained through Boolean operations. No image textures.

rules.name: Neutral closures and simplification
rules.note: Opaque interior closure, unverified fine returns, not measured or observed details.

rules.name: Distinct first-floor pods
rules.note: Three individually projecting polygonal classroom volumes; not extruded into 2F.

rules.name: Separately registered second floor
rules.note: 2F classroom wall y=0 behind 1F pod roofs; left entry wing recessed.

rules.name: Third-floor full high wing and attached library
rules.note: Whole connected L, not separate packages.

rules.name: Fourth-floor high wing
rules.note: Low wing is roof; upper front balcony group and rear balcony group differ.

rules.name: Fifth-floor high wing
rules.note: Asymmetric upper balcony/window groups; not sixth complete storey.

rules.name: Distinct rear high facade
rules.note: Long recessed central groups at upper storeys, small core windows, different from plaza.

rules.name: Three-storey library outer and inner faces
rules.note: Wide multistorey grass-side glazing, narrow windows and ground bands; inner face not mirrored.

rules.name: Own open end stairs
rules.note: Open high free-end switchback flights/landings and library free-end stair. Steps/guards simplified and thickened.

rules.name: Plain roofs and unequal subdivided cores
rules.note: Plain neutral low roof; plan roof garden omitted due photographic conflict. Two principal unequal roof/core groups, junction subdivided.

rules.name: Limited approach and display base
rules.note: Authored L-shaped display plinth below grade. No campus lawn or shared A/B basement. Local steps approximate.

rules.name: A-side connection termination
rules.note: Stop at A exterior wall; retain recessed local aperture. No chapel bridge, distant portal or floating bridge stump.
